text:
Samir K.: Heads-up — Priya starts on-call next Monday. Can we run through the exact checklist so she isn't blocked on day 1?
Priya K.: Thanks! Quick Qs: pager access, runbook read perms, and who to shadow for my first 2 shifts?
Alex W.: Welcome Priya :wave: PagerDuty invite usually goes out after Okta group add. @devex can you confirm the group name?
Devexbot: auto: devex-request received. Common group: redwood-oncall-new-hires. Submit access request via https://okta.example.com/app/requests/new (add "oncall-new-hires")
Priya K.: Got it — I don't see the group in Okta yet. Who's the reviewer?
Samir K.: Reviewer is @Alex W. I'll approve once you submit. Also need VPN + SSO to Confluence for runbooks.
Alex W.: Runbook perms: add to confluence space "eng-oncall". If you can't view a doc, ping me and I'll add explicit view. Docs to read: "Incident Triage", "Pager Playbook", "Escalation Matrix". Links: https://confluence.redwood/infer/eng-oncall/runbooks
Jess L.: I'll shadow your first night shift (UTC-8). We can do a pre-shift 30min walkthrough today or tomorrow. What time works for you?
Priya K.: Evening PST is ideal. Thanks Jess! Also — where do we get the test incidents for practice?
Alex W.: We use the staging incident generator: run `./tools/staging-inject -s smoke` from the infra repo. Example: ```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/infra.git
cd infra/tools
./staging-inject -s smoke
```
Priya K.: I don't have SSH keys set up for Github yet. Any quick steps?
Devexbot: checklist item: set up SSH keys. Docs: https://docs.redwood/devex/ssh-keys. If you hit permission denied, request git-access in Okta form.
Samir K.: Also remember the pager hygiene training — 15m async + 45m live runthrough. Oncall Bot will schedule the live session.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: New-hire on-call training scheduled — please complete async module "Oncall 101" before live session. Link: https://learn.redwood/oncall-101
Alex W.: For first week schedule: Priya you get a light first-week rotation: 1 shadowed primary, 1 shadowed secondary, then 1 solo with Jess on-call as backup. We'll mark your shifts as "mentor-assisted" in PagerDuty so alerts route to both of you.
Priya K.: Perfect. Any special secrets / KMS access I need for triage?
Samir K.: You'll need read access to customer-prod-key for logs scraping — request via the KMS access form and tag it with "oncall-access". Ops will grant temporary creds for first 2 weeks.
Jess L.: Quick tip: when you escalate to L2, always include `#incident:summary` snippet and last 3 error traces. Saves a ton of back-and-forth.
Priya K.: Love that. Last nit: how do I mark myself off the rotation if I need a day swap?
Alex W.: Use the PagerDuty schedule UI -> "Request Override" and ping #eng-oncall for visibility. If it's <2h before shift, escalate to me and we'll find a replacement.
Priya K.: All set, I'll submit Okta requests now and follow the checklist links. Thanks everyone! :smile:
Samir K.: Awesome — welcome aboard again. We'll do a short retro after your first week to tighten the checklist.
Oncall Bot: auto: Checklist summary sent to Priya K. — items: Okta group, PagerDuty invite, SSH keys, Confluence access, KMS request, Oncall 101 async.
thread_summary: new-hire onboarding checklist and shadowing plan for on-call rotation
